name: Moonbase
overview: Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin with web app hosting, settings sync, theming, and Seerr integrations
description: Moonbase is the Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin, powering settings sync, the Moonfin Web app at /Moonfin/Web/, a built-in theme editor with custom theme APIs, media bar and ratings integrations, and Seerr proxy/SSO with admin defaults and broadcasts across Moonfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Screenshot test release from feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final2 (c69b1abf9ca656f38005c6047af6300bc14bd2a3).

- Clarify that Moonfin identifies Cinema Mode trailers so viewers can check availability and request movies or TV series through Seerr.
- Explain that pairing movie trailers with movies and TV trailers with episodes is necessary only for title-only filename identification fallback.
- Updated Jellyfin and Emby administrator descriptions, without changing resolver behavior.
- Full Jellyfin, Emby and salvage tests, both plugin builds, and ZIP checks passed.
- PR branch and its version files were not changed.

Test release from feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final2 (96359475a91de1631c7ee983a0fb1f5551df1114).

- Include all Cinema Mode changes from the clean six-commit PR branch and the latest upstream Moonbase changes.
- Remove temporary CinemaDiag logging while preserving the Jellyfin item-query compatibility fix.
- Retain metadata, attached-owner recovery, provider-ID mapping, and the optional filename-title fallback.
- Full Jellyfin and Emby test suites, salvage tests, builds, and package checks passed.
- The PR branch and its version files are unchanged.

Cinema Mode compatibility fix (feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final, 07d540ee61b30b26919647c7c353a99c5c7bf0de).

- Fix MissingMethodException on Jellyfin 10.11+ when finding an attached trailer with the same file path as a private Cinema Mode video.
- Replace the incompatible GetItemList query with GetItemsResult(query).Items, whose method signature is stable across Jellyfin 10.10 and newer versions.
- Retain the existing exact-path ownership and unique-owner rules; no settings or filename behavior changed.
- Include temporary [CinemaDiag] logs to verify trailer and owner identity during a replay. The diagnostics remain in their own removable commit.

Diagnostic test build from feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final (75576f9f3007b91a003b1ec7d5fb0ab1422fd62b).

- Add temporary [CinemaDiag] information-level logs to trace the Cinema Mode identity lookup for private intro videos.
- Log incoming requests, played video ID/path, attached trailer exact-path matches and OwnerIds, owner/series TMDB metadata, and final response.
- No changes to Cinema Mode identification, access, or settings. The diagnostic code is in one removable commit.
- After installing this version, replay the test Trailer.mp4 before an episode, then check Jellyfin Dashboard > Logs for [CinemaDiag] entries.

Cinema Mode test update from feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final (62ef43e85a3587c919f1e39848c89c31af69a4bb).

- Identify private trailers using Jellyfin's library metadata without requiring the played video, matching attached trailer, or owning movie/series to be visible through user-scoped library lookups.
- Preserve the exact-path attached trailer ownership match, unambiguous owner requirement, and metadata conflict checks.
- Keep the Cinema Mode resolver endpoint authenticated; Seerr independently validates request permissions.
- Update regression tests for private attached trailers and remove the obsolete user-scoped lookup requirement.

Cinema Mode test build from feat/cinema-mode-skip-trailer-settings-final (681a7e291b8189f1f05d6805ed89d3141f0c40df).

- Recover the advertised movie or series from an attached trailer sharing a private video's exact file path (Jellyfin and Emby).
- Add an optional filename-based TMDB title lookup fallback, disabled by default; normal metadata, attached-owner and embedded-ID identification continues to work without enabling it.
- Ignore generic promotional-only filenames such as Trailer.mp4 and Official Trailer.mp4.
- Clarify Cinema Mode's Seerr Request and availability identification settings.
